A lively illustrated poster reads “1000 Followers!” in enormous, uneven carnival lettering. The numerals across the top glow orange, yellow, and red, with thick black outlines and paint drips. Cream-colored letters spelling “Followers!” curve across the middle, casting deep red and black shadows. Wide-eyed paint creatures peek out from behind and below the words: a spiky black one at left, a blue one reaching in from the right, and smaller red, blue, yellow, and olive creatures clustered near the bottom. Orange stars, curved strokes, splashes, and droplets scatter across a warm beige background. The textured brushwork and crowded composition make the whole poster feel as though the lettering and creatures have burst from the same pot of paint.
